title: Repeat Reinspections in Twelve Months: Billing Q&A, Calloway Limited Home Warranty
content:
*How do earlier reinspection charges bear on the visit charge of a re-measurement under the Calloway Limited Home Warranty?* Through the repeat-reinspection multiplier, applied to the program's reinspection fee.

**Rule.** The repeat-reinspection multiplier counts the reinspection charges already assessed on the coverage within the last 12 calendar months (dated later than the same calendar day 12 months before the assessment day): two or more take 1.50; exactly one takes 1.25; none takes 1.00, that is, no adjustment.

*Which charges are counted?* Reinspection charges already assessed on the same coverage, on any claim item, dated inside the window.

*Where does the window start?* Assessed on 3 November 2025, the window takes reinspection charges dated 4 November 2024 or later; one dated 3 November 2024 is outside it.

*Is the charge now being worked out counted?* No; only charges already assessed are counted.

| Reinspection charges already assessed in the last 12 calendar months | Repeat-reinspection multiplier |
|---|---|
| 0 | 1.00 |
| 1 | 1.25 |
| 2 | 1.50 |
| 3 or more | 1.50 |
